researchNotes: Official site (nishane.com) perfumes category read: 66 listed items across six pages. Minis/15 ml travel bottles, samples, travel and discovery sets and hair perfumes excluded. Each full-size perfume was read on its official product page for notes, concentration and family. Perfumer is stated only for Tuberóza X. Release years are not stated on the product pages, so they are null. Brand country is not stated on the pages read. Hold Me Closer's page gives no concentration.

fragrances.name: Hacivat

sources.name: Parfumo — Nishane Hacivat reviews (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo review snippets (search result only): many report long wear (some 12+ h, others 5-7 h), so most common view set to level 4; sillage described as strong up close but moderate overall, level 3. Hacivat X and Hacivat Oud not used.

fragrances.name: Deziro

sources.name: Fragscentric — Nishane Deziro: A Full Wear Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragscentric full-wear review: 7-8 hours noticeable and 10-12 as a skin scent; projection strong for 2-3 hours, moderate to about hour 6; suggests spring and summer, office, casual daytime and dinner dates.

fragrances.name: Tuberoza X

sources.name: Parfumexquis — In-Depth Review: Nishane Deziro and Tuberoza X

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumexquis blog review: longevity 'remarkable', easily over 10 hours on the reviewer's skin; says it shines in fall and winter.

fragrances.name: Shinanay
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfumista.vn product page: lasts 6-12 hours with strong sillage; recommended for evening events in autumn, spring and winter.

fragrances.name: Hundred Silent Ways X

sources.name: Scents Angel — Nishane Hundred Silent Ways X Extrait de Parfum
Perfumista.vn — Hundred Silent Ways X review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel listing: 10-12+ hours, strong sillage, moderate-to-strong projection; Perfumista.vn: 6-12 hours, for autumn and winter evenings.

fragrances.name: Hacivat X

sources.name: Basenotes — Positive Reviews of Hacivat X by Nishane

fragrances.performanceEvidence: TPRofumo review: about 7-10 hours on skin, clear projection for 1-2 hours then within arm's length; Basenotes reviewer: strong longevity, projection below Aventus levels, suited to summer evenings.

fragrances.name: Wulong Cha X

sources.name: Lemon8 — Nishane Wulong Cha X: My Honest Review on Longevity & Sillage

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Lemon8 review by Fields of Fragrance: 7-8 hours, up to 9-10 with generous application; polite arm's-length bubble for 2-3 hours, moderate sillage; worn to the office, brunch and evenings.

fragrances.name: Ani X

sources.name: Parfum Exquis — Vibrato and Ani X: A Perfume Stylist's Insight

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfum Exquis stylist blog: 10-12 hours longevity, strong projection early then an intimate dry-down; best in fall and winter, fine on cool spring days, not for hot summer.

fragrances.name: Sultan Vetiver

sources.name: Parfumo — Nishane Sultan Vetiver (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo community averages about 8.7/10 longevity and 8.2/10 sillage; Thescentbase lists good projection and 8+ h; Venba claims 10+ h with strong sillage; Beautinow claims 8-10 h with moderate sillage. Most common view: longevity 4 (typically 8-10 h), sillage 4.

fragrances.name: Wulong Cha

sources.name: Vivir — Nishane Wulong Cha (search result text)
Parfumo — Nishane Wulong Cha reviews (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir cites 6-8 h longevity and softer projection (3/5 sillage); Parfumo reviewers report more than 8 h on one batch and close, skin-hugging sillage; one reviewer says 12 h. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 2. Wulong Cha X not used. Vivir page shows placeholder zeros in places, so it was weighted less.

fragrances.name: Tuberoza

sources.name: Parfumo — Nishane Tuberoza reviews (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo reviewers on the 2014 original Tuberóza extrait: about 10 h with projection hard to miss, though one reports fading after about 5 h; retailers claim 8-12 h with strong or moderate-to-strong sillage. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 4. Tuberoza X (2024) not covered and a Fragrance Review note of gentle sillage was not used.

fragrances.name: Afrika-Olifant

sources.name: Colognoisseur — Nishane Istanbul Afrika Olifant review
CaFleureBon — Nishane Istanbul Afrika Olifant review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Colognoisseur: overnight longevity and average sillage; CaFleureBon: lingers more than a day, sits close to skin with well-regulated sillage.

fragrances.name: Fan Your Flames

sources.name: Scento — Fan Your Flames (search result text)
Parfumo — Nishane Fan Your Flames reviews (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo user ratings mostly 8-9 for longevity and sillage; Beautinow listing gives 8-10 h with moderate to strong trail; Scento aggregate says long-lasting with strong projection, best for winter and night. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 4. Fan Your Flames X flanker not used.

fragrances.name: Hundred Silent Ways

sources.name: Scento — Hundred Silent Ways (search result text)
Thescentbase — Hundred Silent Ways (search result text)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento aggregated user data (for the 2016 Extrait, search text): long-lasting with moderate projection, suggested for fall and night; Thescentbase lists 6+ h; Beautinow lists moderate projection with moderate to strong sillage. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 3. X and Amarena flankers not used.

fragrances.name: Zenne

sources.name: The Sniff Test — Nishane Zenne (search result text)
Parfumo — Nishane Zenne reviews (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo reviewer 9-10 h; retailer and Vioral London list 8-10 h / 8+ h; sillage mixed: strong per ScentArt and one Parfumo reviewer, moderate per a retailer (7/10) and The Sniff Test. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 3. Scento 12-18 h claim belonged to other Nishane fragrances and was excluded.

fragrances.name: Karagoz
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo user review: about 8 h with moderate sillage; another Parfumo reviewer rates it 10 for longevity and 9 for sillage. Sellers claim 10-12 h or over 12 h with strong sillage, but these are marketing figures and were given less weight. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 3. Concentration not confirmed on the entry.

fragrances.name: B-612

sources.name: Basenotes — Positive Reviews of B-612 by Nishane

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes review: projection beyond arm's length for roughly 3-4 hours, late drydown lasts about 10 hours and longer on clothes.

fragrances.name: Vain & Naive

sources.name: WhatScent — Sweet, Synthetic & Shamelessly Feminine: Vain & Naive review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: WhatScent user review (OliveEyes): overnight longevity, tenacious projection, rated 5/5 longevity, 4/5 projection and 4/5 sillage.

fragrances.name: Colognise

sources.name: Reviewr — Nishane Colognise Extrait De Cologne

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Reviewr review: longevity 6+ hours, moderate sillage projecting up to about 6 feet; suited to mild spring afternoons.

fragrances.name: Safran Colognise

sources.name: Scent Grail — Nishane Safran Colognise Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scent Grail review after three years of wear: typically over 24 hours on skin, solid projection and sillage for over 6 hours; worn across all four seasons.

fragrances.name: Ani

sources.name: Parfumo — Nishane Ani reviews (search result text only, page not opened)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Thescentbase lists long-lasting 8+ hours with good projection; Parfumo reviewers report 10-16 h and strong sillage, while one 2024 reviewer rated both 6/10. Most common view: longevity 4, sillage 4. Ani X (flanker) and its winter wording not used.

fragrances.name: Nefs
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes forum post: persistent skin-sticking longevity of 12+ hours; strong enough that the poster limits sprays to keep projection near one foot.

fragrances.name: Shem
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfume Picks community scores: longevity 3/5, sillage 3/5

fragrances.name: Unutamam

sources.name: The Plum Girl — Unutamam Perfume Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Plum Girl review: sillage is strong, longevity above average (no hours given).
